Famous Tourist Places in Visakhapatnam – Book Your Sightseeing Cab

Discover Vizag’s Beaches, Temples & Coastal Attractions

Explore the beautiful coastal city of Visakhapatnam with Abhi Cabs 24×7 Vizag sightseeing taxi services. Discover beaches, hill viewpoints, museums, temples, and family attractions with a convenient local cab.

  • RK Beach

    Visit Ramakrishna Beach (RK Beach), one of Visakhapatnam’s popular coastal attractions. Enjoy seaside views, the beach promenade, and nearby museums.

  • Kailasagiri Hill Park

    Explore Kailasagiri, a scenic hilltop destination offering panoramic views of the Bay of Bengal, landscaped gardens, and popular viewpoints.

  • Rushikonda Beach

    Plan a visit to Rushikonda Beach, known for its golden sands and coastal scenery. A popular destination for beach outings and family sightseeing.

  • Simhachalam Temple

    Visit Sri Varaha Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy Temple at Simhachalam, a major spiritual landmark near Visakhapatnam. Choose a local taxi for your temple visit.

  • INS Kurusura Submarine Museum

    Explore the INS Kurusura Submarine Museum near RK Beach, where visitors can learn about naval history inside a decommissioned submarine.

  • TU-142 Aircraft Museum

    Discover the TU-142 Aircraft Museum near Beach Road, featuring a retired Indian Navy maritime aircraft and aviation exhibits.

  • Yarada Beach

    Visit Yarada Beach, known for its scenic coastline, surrounding hills, and peaceful natural landscape.

  • Dolphin’s Nose Lighthouse

    Explore the Dolphin’s Nose area, known for its distinctive hill formation and views of Visakhapatnam’s coastal surroundings.

  • Indira Gandhi Zoological Park

    Plan a family outing to Indira Gandhi Zoological Park, known for its wildlife exhibits and natural setting.

  • Visakha Museum

    Discover regional history, cultural artefacts, and heritage exhibits at Visakha Museum along the Beach Road area.

Popular One-Day Trip Destinations Near Visakhapatnam

Explore Scenic Hills, Beaches & Heritage Destinations

Looking for places to visit near Vizag? Abhi Cabs 24×7 offers one-day trip cab booking enquiries from Visakhapatnam for nature outings, heritage sightseeing, family trips, and temple visits.

  • Visakhapatnam to Bheemili

    Visit Bheemunipatnam (Bheemili), known for its beach, coastal scenery, and historic surroundings. A popular choice for short family outings.

  • Visakhapatnam to Thotlakonda

    Explore Thotlakonda, an ancient Buddhist heritage site located along the coastal route near Visakhapatnam.

  • Visakhapatnam to Bavikonda

    Discover Bavikonda, another historically important Buddhist site known for its archaeological remains and hilltop setting.

  • Visakhapatnam to Kambalakonda Wildlife Sanctuary

    Plan a nature outing to Kambalakonda Wildlife Sanctuary, known for its forest landscape and ecotourism experiences.

  • Visakhapatnam to Borra Caves

    Explore Borra Caves, famous for their natural limestone formations in the Eastern Ghats. Plan sufficient travel time for the hill-road journey.

  • Visakhapatnam to Araku Valley

    Visit Araku Valley, a scenic hill destination known for coffee plantations, mountain landscapes, and tribal cultural attractions. An early start is recommended for a same-day return.

  • Visakhapatnam to Ananthagiri Hills

    Discover Ananthagiri Hills on the route towards Araku, known for greenery, scenic roads, and beautiful Eastern Ghats landscapes.

  • Visakhapatnam to Vizianagaram

    Explore Vizianagaram, known for its historical landmarks, temples, and regional heritage. Suitable for family outings and personal travel.

Important Things to Know Before Booking a Vizag Cab

Plan Your Coastal, Airport & Outstation Journey with Confidence

  • Pickup Location

    Enter your complete address, hotel, railway station, or nearby landmark.

  • Airport Location

    For scheduled commercial flights, use Bhogapuram Airport rather than the former INS Dega civil terminal.

  • Airport Travel

    Allow sufficient time to reach Bhogapuram from your pickup location, considering traffic and check-in requirements.

  • Beach Visits

    Check weather conditions, sea warnings, and local safety restrictions. Not every beach is safe for swimming.

  • Araku & Borra Caves

    Plan hill journeys considering road conditions, travel time, and attraction opening hours.

  • Sightseeing

    Review museum timings, entry fees, temple schedules, and seasonal closures.

  • Hourly Rentals

    Confirm included hours, kilometres, waiting charges, and additional fees.

  • Outstation Fares

    Check tolls, parking fees, permits, and driver allowances.

  • Vehicle Selection

    Choose suitable seating and luggage capacity for your journey.

  • Advance Booking

    Plan ahead for holidays, festivals, weekends, and popular tourist periods.
